name: 使用 SAP Business Network 和 SAP Fieldglass 的服务采购 (4R2)
name_en: Service Procurement with SAP Business Network and SAP Fieldglass (4R2)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item covers the creation and approval of purchase orders for services. Alternatively, the process can be triggered via the creation of a purchase requisition, which is later converted to a purchase order.

The service fulfillment can be steered and monitored with the supplier side statement of work, supplier time sheets, and service entry sheets. Afterwards, the invoicing process is triggered.

The scope item covers standard service items and can be conducted with different optional steps. Service procurement using free text description of services in procurement documents is also supported.

Key Process Flow

  • Manage purchase requisitions
  • Manage purchase orders
  • Manage supplier confirmations for services and start and end dates
  • Manage statement of work for services requested
  • Manage service provider time sheets for services performed
  • Manage service entry sheets
  • Manage invoices

Business Benefits

  • Provide efficient and cost-effective streamlined procurement processes as collaboration between buyers, purchaser, and suppliers
  • Ensure highly automated processes for the service procurement
  • Reduce manual effort greatly
  • Perform real-time monitoring of the service fulfillment
  • Monitor purchase order items with analytical list page
  • Handle service provider on-boarding and service task management in scope and service
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目涵盖创建和审批服务采购订单。或者，可以通过创建采购申请（稍后转换为采购订单）来触发该流程。

可以通过供应商方面的工作声明、供应商时间表和服务条目表来引导和监控服务履行。之后，触发开发票流程。

此范围项目涵盖标准服务项目，可通过不同的可选步骤执行。还支持使用采购凭证中服务的自由文本描述进行服务采购。

关键流程流

  • 管理采购申请
  • 管理采购订单
  • 管理服务的供应商确认，以及开始和结束日期
  • 管理所请求服务的工作声明
  • 管理已执行服务的服务提供商时间表
  • 管理服务条目表
  • 管理发票

业务优势

  • 通过采购商、采购商和供应商之间的协作，提供经济高效的简化采购流程
  • 确保服务采购的高度自动化流程
  • 大幅减少手动工作量
  • 实时监控服务履行情况
  • 使用分析列表页面监控采购订单项目
  • 处理范围内服务提供商的启用和服务任务管理，并进行服务
